title: cancel() races every concurrent disk scan - a two-step delete under unguarded fs.stat readers, surfacing as a 500 on /comfy/models/check
description: UMBRELLA: MPI-717 - One slow install, three defects on the local download path (consolidation sweep 2026-09-10). Members and phase order: tasks/MPI-717/plan.md. FileDownloader.cancel() removes the partial and then its .cubricdl marker in two steps while two readers walk the same tree: findFileRecursive (routes/shared.js - readdir, then an unguarded fs.stat per entry, markers included) and getPartialDownloadState (routes/downloadCompletion.js - two pathExists, then an unguarded fs.stat). Captured 2026-09-10: two 'models/check failed' ENOENT errors 102 ms after a cancel, one on a weight and one on a marker, each dropping a syncModelInstalled reconcile. Not a guard at the crash site: no lock coordinates a route reader with cancel, so a vanished entry is a defined outcome of the walk and the shared primitives must treat ENOENT as absent - both readers, one pass. Same symptom family as MPI-513 (install state that lies), different root. Code trace, not executed - repro is step one.
